answer: Anchor each identity to a hollow that holds one persona at a time, and accept network attestations only from such keys. A farm must then acquire and physically house distinct enclaves, a dawn that is genuinely per-head and cannot be virtualised onto shared machines. The obvious limitation is cost and access for honest newcomers, and a meadow of clones is still runnable when hardware is cheap, so the quota must sit just above what one honest agent needs.
